KRDP Recruitment 2026: Online Applications Open for 12,878 Group B and C Vacancies

The Khadi Reforms and Development Programme (KRDP), operating under the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises, has officially launched a recruitment drive aiming to fill 12,878 Group B and Group C posts. The registration process opened on October 26, 2026, giving prospective candidates until late November to complete their applications through the official web portal.

This comprehensive recruitment covers a wide array of roles across various departments, offering opportunities for individuals holding diverse educational qualifications ranging from secondary school certificates to advanced postgraduate degrees.

Vacancy Distribution and Key Dates

The recruitment drive features 3,602 Group B positions and 9,276 Group C positions, totaling 12,878 tentative vacancies under advertisement number Adm. I-/NGR/KRDP/2 (117)/2026-27.

Key dates associated with the recruitment process include:

  • Application Start Date: October 26, 2026
  • Registration Last Date: November 25, 2026
  • Application Submission Last Date: November 30, 2026
  • Correction Window: December 2–4, 2026
  • Exam Date: To be announced

Notable Group B positions include Khadi Development Officer (410), Khadi Inspector (421), Account Officer (405), Technical Officer (596), Field Officer (1,026), Executive (Khadi) (308), and Executive (Village Industries) (436). Among Group C roles are Supervisor Grade III (834), Junior Assistant (1,206), Village Industries Worker (2,140), Lower Division Clerk (1,232), Driver (152), and Multi Tasking Staff (MTS) (3,712).

Eligibility Requirements and Application Process

Educational qualifications vary significantly depending on the specific post chosen. While some positions require a Class 10 or Class 12 qualification, others necessitate undergraduate or postgraduate degrees. Candidates must fulfill all educational criteria by November 30, 2026. Additionally, government employees applying to the drive may benefit from an upper age limit of up to 45 years, subject to applicable guidelines.

The application fee for UR, EWS, OBC (NCL), and SC/ST categories is listed as Nil in the official notification. Eligible individuals can apply online by visiting the official website at krdp.org.in, completing Step I registration using a valid email ID and mobile number, logging in to fill out personal and educational details, uploading necessary documents, and submitting the form before the deadline.

Practical Implications and Verification

Candidates preparing to apply should carefully review the official notification to match their qualifications with specific post requirements before initiating registration. Utilizing the correction window between December 2 and 4, 2026, is recommended for addressing any unintentional errors made during initial submissions.

Readers can independently verify all announcements, check detailed eligibility breakdowns, and access direct application links by visiting the official portal at [krdp.org.in](https://www.krdp.org.in).
